integrity: The proof uses the source theorem exactly as stated and an elementary exact optimization of its total-horizon profile; finite computations are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: Optimization is restricted to the measured-address dephasing subfamily and to the margin/noise range of Theorem V.1. The exact capacity-maximizing split is not identified because the source theorem is only uniform up to multiplicative constants.
title: Exponential total-horizon capacity from address loading in the measured dephasing family
